mapper.select: SELECT RP.PROJECT_ID, RP.PROJECT_NAME, SUM(CASE WHEN TS.TASK_STATUS_ID = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS created, SUM(CASE WHEN TS.TASK_STATUS_ID = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inProgress, SUM(CASE WHEN TS.TASK_STATUS_ID = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS devDone, SUM(CASE WHEN TS.TASK_STATUS_ID = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rejected, SUM(CASE WHEN TS.TASK_STATUS_ID = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS done, COUNT(T.TASK_ID) AS totalSum FROM PROJECTS RP LEFT JOIN PROJECTS CP ON CP.PARENT_PROJECT_ID = RP.PROJECT_ID OR CP.PROJECT_ID = RP.PROJECT_ID LEFT JOIN TASKS T ON T.PROJECT_ID = CP.PROJECT_ID LEFT JOIN TASK_STATUSES TS ON T.TASK_STATUS_ID = TS.TASK_STATUS_ID WHERE RP.PARENT_PROJECT_ID IS NULL GROUP BY RP.PROJECT_ID, RP.PROJECT_NAME ORDER BY RP.PROJECT_ID
